description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Muthugala, Welikanda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District (25/0254)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations regarding specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and other land-related particulars. The document is explicitly published in "PART III - LANDS" and involves the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement making determinations about land titles, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
